title: Relief on the Service Charge for Members Holding Bushels under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements
content:
A member who has bushels on hand with the cooperative under Grain Storage and Conditioning Agreements carries relief against the service charge worked out on their crop input account, and the relief is the deeper where they have already settled storage charges on those bushels.

**Clause.** Where the member has bushels on hand under a live storage agreement with the cooperative and a storage charge settlement stands on that agreement over the 10 statement months before the handling date, the charge worked out at the rate is halved — taken at 0.5 of itself — and rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. Where the member has bushels on hand under a live storage agreement with the cooperative and no storage charge settlement stands on it over those months, the charge worked out at the rate is taken at three quarters of itself — 0.75 of itself — and rounded half away from zero to two decimal places. In every other case no relief is taken against the charge worked out at the rate on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Bushels on hand under a live storage agreement | Storage charge settlement standing over the 10 statement months | The charge worked out at the rate is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| held | one or more | Taken at 0.5 of itself, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places |
| held | none | Taken at 0.75 of itself, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places |
| not held | either | Taken with no relief |

The rounding falls once, half away from zero, at the end of the step in which the relief is taken. *Hypothetical reading.* A charge worked out at the rate of 431.67 USD carrying the deeper relief comes to 215.84 USD; carrying the lighter relief it comes to 323.75 USD.
